messages:
pagerduty-bot: 🔔 ALERT: Elevated 5xx + timeouts observed for /v1/generate across api-prod-west. 5xx rate ~12% over last 3m, 429s spiking as well. Paging sam (oncall).

sam (oncall): on it. looking at grafana now. which region?

pagerduty-bot: region=api-prod-west, cluster=gpu-pool-3, affected_routes=[/v1/generate, /v1/chat].

lee (sre): i'm seeing a big surge in 429s coming from quota service: quota-check latency backpressure -> gateway timeouts to transformers. prefix cache ok.

maya (eng): tagging in — recent deploy? i rolled a small quota-policy change to apply global hard-limits 15m ago.

sam (oncall): @maya can you confirm the change and patch id?

maya (eng): reverted to canary then promoted. patch: qp-2026-03-14-7. rule: enforce_strict_global=true, default_per_key=1000/min. i added a stricter global cap to avoid noisy neighbors.

lee (sre): that matches timeline. quota-service started returning 429s, our API gateway treats 429s as overload and starts shedding -> some downstream retries causing 5xx from transformer pool. cascading.

toni (support): customers reporting timeouts. Support queue lighting up; top affected: acme-inc (high priority), docsflow; may impact any chat/generation flows.

sam (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) rollback quota-policy to previous (maya) 2) enable soft-fail on quota-service so downstream receives 200+warning instead of hard 429 3) add temporary routing to dedicated-fallback cluster for high-value customers. I'll execute 1 and 2 unless objections.

maya (eng): agree. i'll push rollback. running command: 
```
# rollback quota policy
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/redwood/v1/quota/policy/rollback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"policy_id":"qp-2026-03-14-6"}'
```

maya (eng): rolled back to qp-2026-03-14-6. response: {"status":"ok","applied_at":"1802345692"}

lee (sre): changing quota-service behavior to soft-fail now. patching configmap: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap quota-config -p '{"data":{"enforce_strict":"false","soft_fail":"true"}}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy queued for configmap update in cluster gpu-pool-3. rollout started.

sam (oncall): confirming gateway now sees fewer 429s? grafana shows 429s dropping from 11% -> 2% in last 40s. 5xx also trending down.

toni (support): notifying top affected customers: sending proactive message to acme-inc and docsflow with ETA ~15m.

maya (eng): i'm enabling temporary routing rule for enterprise IDs to dedicated-fallback via feature flag: 
```
POST /ops/route/override {"selector":"customer_tag:enterprise","target":"dedicated-fallback"}
```

lee (sre): routing in place. traffic shift ~8% of total, but includes high-value flows. no errors observed on dedicated-fallback.

sam (oncall): progress update: rollback + soft-fail + targeted routing implemented. error rates back to baseline ~0.8% 5xx. keeping on-call watch for 30m.

toni (support): support notified customers, asking for any persistent errors to open tickets with logs.

maya (eng): root cause: overly aggressive global quota rule combined with gateway retry semantics. will follow up with postmortem and a safer rollout checklist.

lee (sre): immediate follow-ups: 1) revert gateway retry behavior for 429->no retry for 60s 2) add telemetry on quota-policy promotions (who/when) 3) add canary throttle test to CI.

sam (oncall): handing off incident to lee for post-incident ops during US night. i'm available until 12:30 UTC.

lee (sre): I'll own the postmortem and mitigation tasks. creating incident card and linking runbook.

deploy-bot: incident runbook created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1802345678.

toni (support): logging customer impact: ~14% tenants saw >2x latency, 3 tenants had >25% failed requests during window. adding to incident notes.

maya (eng): dev action items pinned. will add automated revert safety check so global hard-limits require ack from SRE and canary for 30m.

sam (oncall): thanks team. i'll update #incidents-super and then resume pagerduty standby. :thumbsup:

lee (sre): closing alert in pagerduty. monitoring for 1h.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Elevated 5xx/429 in api-prod-west mitigated. duration ~9m. severity: P2.
